name: P.A.M. (Perks and Mini)

prices.note: Store prices in AUD. P.A.M.'s own hoodies only (the store also sells other labels): MAAP x P.A.M. 4.0 Hoodie A$215, PAM X BoTT Split Hooded Sweat A$241, Celestial Equator Hooded Zip Thru Sweat A$322, Message Board Hooded Zip Thru A$322, Magical Door 2.0 Hooded Zip Thru A$387, PAM Logo Hooded Zip Thru Khaki A$396. Sizes XS–XL, most stop at L or XL. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no markdown tag (markdown, clearance, outlet, final sale, sale-NN, NN% off, saleonsale, Apparel_Sale_). Hoodies only: pullover and zip-up hooded sweatshirts; crewnecks, hooded jackets, vests, knit hats/hoods, kids and sets excluded.

notes: Meta: 'P.A.M. is an Independent Brand and Creative Studio. P.A.M. Stores Melbourne, Sydney and Online... Showcasing two seasonal P.A.M. collections per year, a selection of international brands, as well as collaborations'.

Shipping: free worldwide over AUD 450 (about $316 at ECB 2026-10-28); ships DDU, duties paid by the buyer. USA tariffs page: US buyers may be invoiced by DHL for import tariffs plus a brokerage fee after ordering.
Returns or exchanges within 14 days from the date of purchase.
